scope: Stress tests of seven precisely stated shortcuts; no automatic theorem discovery or Millennium solutions.

findings.tested_claim: Existence of a nondegenerate alternating pairing alone determines the dimension of the underlying vector space.
findings.reasoning: Block diagonal symplectic forms are nondegenerate in dimensions 2,4,8, and in every positive even dimension. Duality alone does not select one dimension.
findings.limitation: These vector spaces are not Selmer groups or elliptic curves; no counterexample to BSD or its actual arithmetic duality statements is claimed.
findings.next_obligation: Prove the precise analytic/arithmetic comparison; additional arithmetic input is indispensable.

findings.tested_claim: Declaring a rational cohomological space to be of type (p,p) forces a specified cycle map onto it.
findings.reasoning: In Q^2, the image of q -> (q,0) misses (0,1), regardless of an assigned type label. Surjectivity does not follow from these abstract data.
findings.limitation: Not realized as the cycle map of a smooth projective variety. Thus this is not a Hodge counterexample and cannot refute arguments using additional geometric structure.
findings.next_obligation: Use the actual geometry to construct rational algebraic cycles and prove coverage.

findings.tested_claim: Helicity and dilation-preserved vortex topology alone bound vorticity magnitude for all smooth decaying divergence-free initial fields.
findings.reasoning: Positive dilation preserves vortex-line topology. The family u_lambda(x)=lambda*u(lambda*x) has identical zero helicity and |omega_lambda(0)|=4*lambda^2. Thus no finite bound depending only on these fixed invariants can hold on this family.
findings.limitation: Initial fields only, not a singular evolving solution. Does not reject estimates using additional quantitative hypotheses or all possible geometric approaches.
findings.next_obligation: Prove a quantitative bound with enough geometric and analytic information to close a continuation criterion.

findings.tested_claim: Explicit expansion of the satisfaction polynomial always has polynomially many monomials.

witness.formula: AND_i (x_i OR y_i) on disjoint pairs

findings.reasoning: Each factor has three choices with distinct variable-pair supports. Different choices yield distinct monomials of coefficient +/-1. Hence there are exactly 3^m nonzero monomials for every m>=0.
findings.limitation: No lower bound for arbitrary SAT algorithms or compressed representations. Does not resolve P versus NP.
findings.next_obligation: Specify an algorithm and bound its full bit complexity; a topological invariant also needs an efficient construction and evaluation theorem.

findings.tested_claim: Trivial abelianization of a fundamental group implies that the group is trivial.
findings.reasoning: A5 is nontrivial but equals its commutator subgroup. First homology detects the abelianization and cannot generally replace a simple-connectivity check.
findings.limitation: No closed three-manifold is constructed here, and no challenge to Perelman is implied. Refutes the group-theoretic shortcut only.
findings.next_obligation: Retain exact fundamental-group hypotheses and reconstruct the established geometric argument.

findings.tested_claim: Evenness, real coefficients and strict positivity on the real axis force all zeros of an entire function to be real.
findings.reasoning: The polynomial is even and >=1 on the real axis. The displayed nonreal z satisfies z^4+1=0 exactly.
findings.limitation: Not the zeta or xi function; only refutes a symmetry/positivity-only implication.
findings.next_obligation: Construct a noncircular spectral realization and prove the exact zero correspondence.

findings.tested_claim: A positive gap at every regulator value necessarily gives a positive limiting physical gap.
findings.reasoning: Let spacing a_n=1/n and dimensionless gap mu_n=a_n^2>0. The physical gap mu_n/a_n=1/n tends to zero despite positivity at each n.
findings.limitation: Abstract sequence, not Yang-Mills. No assertion that this sequence occurs in that theory; fixed topological sectors would not supply the missing energy estimate.
findings.next_obligation: Establish a nontrivial continuum theory and a strictly positive regulator-uniform physical gap.
